subject: Autocorrelation from indices when looking at continuous recordings

messages.author: 852a0d114fd5df8e
messages.subject: Autocorrelation from indices when looking at continuous recordings
parts:
Hi again guys,

Just wondering how you all have dealt with autocorrelation in continuous recordings when using indices?

Quick chart from one of my recordings, 45mins long in a river. ACI calculated on each minute with no overlap. We have the issue of minutes being related to the minutes prior.
I know we could increase the interval between the calculations, are there any other ways you have dealt with this issue?

Cheers,
Chris
